provenance.operatorDescription: Makes the now-subscriptions GET fail instead of answering.
provenance.operatorRationale: ReferenceDataService.js:53-56 SWALLOWS the failure and returns null, so CourtRegisterSubscriptions/index.js:23 takes the "No Subscriptions found" exit, the fragment keeps its empty matchedSubscriptions, and OutboundCourtRegister returns null. A reference-data outage silently produces NO REGISTER AT ALL for a child, and nothing anywhere records that it happened. The port must be able to tell this apart from "there genuinely are no subscriptions" — the two are indistinguishable in the legacy, and that is the finding.
